entries.averment: The period of custody is recomputed as on the generation date and pleaded (never stale).
Where a special statute engages a bail bar, the application addresses the applicable test head-on (twin conditions for NDPS s.37 / PMLA s.45; prima-facie-true for UAPA s.43D(5)).

source.ref: s.37 NDPS; s.45 PMLA; s.43D(5) UAPA

entries.averment: A successive application discloses the prior order and pleads a change of circumstance since the prior refusal.

source.ref: successive-bail disclosure; Kalyan Chandra Sarkar v. Rajesh Ranjan

entries.averment: A parity claim references the order granting bail to the co-accused relied upon.
The petitioner undertakes to abide by the conditions of bail and to cooperate with the investigation/trial.
